subtasks.name: half1-pink-cube-and-stick
subtasks.prompt: put the pink cube on top of a blue cube and stand the pink stick straight up in its hole
subtasks.check: Is the pink stick standing upright in the hole of the pink cube, which sits on a blue cube?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers.

subtasks.name: half2-blue-and-yellow
subtasks.prompt: slide the other blue cube onto the top of the standing pink stick, then stand the yellow stick straight up in its hole
subtasks.check: Is the yellow stick standing upright in the hole of a blue cube that sits on top of the upright pink stick?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers.
